state.description: Reconductor/rebuild and convert the 115kV lines from Athena - Union Point - Ray Place Road - Warrenton Primary to 230kV operation. Expand Athena 230kV bus for new line termination, construct 230kV bus at Union Point, and expand 230kV bus at Warrenton Primary for new line termination. Install 230/115kV auto transformers at Union Point Primary and Ray Place Road. Replace limiting network equipment a

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
